events.title: Naughty Nurse Appearing At Next Fest 2026
events.summary: Naughty Nurse has been registered to appear at Steam's Next Fest 2026 for upcoming titles. This will allow players to demo the game, submit feedback and improvements, and have curators try it out. The game will be available as a demo for the festival, showcasing the Asylum map and new gameplay features (taser system, Teddy, etc) from October 19-26, 2026.After the conclusion of Steam's Next Fest, the game will go to Early Access on October 30th, and playtesting round 1 will be concluded.
